answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A knoll of per-task receipts records who did what, and the velvet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
